_rule: Prepared BEFORE any run (AGENTS.md), 2026-11-20, branch claude/r2-layer. STAGED, not queued, not authorized.
question: With rt_as_size_class=1 and rt_cascade_keep_refused=1, do the BLAS chunks of the inn dolly stop holding small ranges in chunks larger than 64 MB, with fewer or equal refusals, no casters left out, and the same energy?
evidence: User log 2026-11-20 16:47-16:48 (0.9.6-hairtest18, Ultra, FG 2x): 162 BLAS chunk refusals, 137 in windows led by the cascade casters (99-189 MB, left out those frames); 4.0 GB reserved in 25-31 chunks (mean 155 MB) for 0.55-1.35 GB live, 0 empty at 16:48:11. Queue log vr-inn.1.233221: reserved 2.0-3.7 GB for 0.53-0.82 GB live, pending under 230 MB, 0 refusals at a 4224 MB cap. Replay: as_chunk_alloc_test dolly, 8 seeds: 53 refusals (all cascade) -> 2, reserve mean 3812 -> 3713 MB for 1459 live.
design: One launch at the inn (vr-inn's save), Ultra, RTX Hair On, FG 3x, visible_unfocused_fg, detailed_logging=1. States off-a / on / off-b (both keys toggled live together). Per state: static 3 periods, wheel dolly out and in (2 periods each), twice, then a static energy window (exposure held, 4 float traces). Rows from the always-on '[mem] ours (window)' line (one per 120-frame window with detailed_logging): reserved, live, pending, free in partly used chunks and its part in chunks over a base chunk, chunks over a base chunk, and the keys' state.
noise_rule: Every threshold is the OFF repeat of the same run: noise(metric) = |off-b - off-a| of the same window kind, plus the AGENTS.md floors (energy 0.5%, counts 1%, cost max(0.1 ms, 1%)).

predicted.holes_in_large_chunks: ON: 'free in partly used chunks (N in chunks over a base chunk)' N at most one cascade or groom chunk's tail (0-30 MB) in every window; OFF: 300-2000 MB after the first dolly (the colonised cascade and groom chunks). The decisive observable.
predicted.reserved_minus_live: ON lower than the OFF mean in the dolly windows by 0-600 MB (replay: -100 MB mean at the cap; at the inn the cap is not reached, so the empty retained large chunks may keep the reserve equal). Equal within noise in the static windows. A rise beyond noise plus 1% is a FAIL.
predicted.refusals: At the inn with a 4224 MB cap the OFF state may show 0 refusals (vr-inn 233221: 0); then ON 0 too, and rt_cascade_keep_refused is not exercised ('[bvh] BLAS refusals' absent). Any ON refusal count above the OFF windows' is a FAIL. If refusals occur, 'left out' must be 0 in ON and every cascade refusal 'previous BLAS kept'.
predicted.faults: 0 in every state: no VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST, no crash, guard never LOW.
predicted.gpu_ms: Scene build GPU ms and rt passes GPU ms equal within noise (no shader change; placement only).
predicted.energy: Static, exposure held: ON mean inside the OFF pair's range widened by 0.5%.

decision: rt_as_size_class becomes a default candidate if holes in large chunks fall beyond noise with no rise in refusals, reserve, GPU ms or energy. rt_cascade_keep_refused stays READY_FOR_LIVE until a run with refusals shows kept frames (it needs a lower budget than this machine's); it may still ship on with the class key since it changes nothing without a refusal.
not_measured_here: Frame time from occluded windows; the per-frame cost of the extra key reads (2 cfg_int per BLAS create and per cascade build, under 0.01 ms).
